sentences.text:
Pravendra Singh Dangi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9
June, 2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Gwl:11759
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Vivek Jain
 On The 9 th Of June, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 16618 of 2025
 Pravendra Singh Dangi
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh

Appearance:
 Shri J.P.Mishra - advocate for the applicant.
 Smt. Padam Shree Agarwal - Pl for the respondent/State.
 Order

This is the first application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 482 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant who is apprehending his arrest in relation to FIR/Crime No.131/2025 registered at Police Station - Indergarh District Datia for the offence punishable under Section 376, 376(2)(N) of IPC and 69 and 351(2) of BNS Act.

2. It is argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the prosecutrix is 21 years old lady and as per the prosecution story, there was physical relation between the prosecutrix and the applicant from July, 2023 till September, 2024 on the pretext of marriage and then in March, 2025, he refused to marry with the prosecutrix and on this ground, the offence has been registered against the applicant.
Learned counsel further contends that the prosecutrix is a major lady and the FIR has been lodged after Six months from the last alleged act of physical relation.
Therefore, the applicant may be NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:11759 2 MCRC-16618-2025 enlarged on bail.
3. Per contra, learned counsel for the State had vehemently opposed the bail application on the basis of the documents and material available on record and prayed for its rejection.

4. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties and on perusal of case diary,
without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a bail bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Station House Officer/Arresting Officer of the Police Station concerned.
